summary: How a person gets from installing Ecobex to reading their footprint, contributing to a climate project, joining the leaderboard and changing settings.
verdict: Five flows for one role, all planned. Three decisions block building: the project rules still say no accounts, the onboarding needs a consent step the Chrome Web Store requires, and no offset provider is chosen yet.

provenance.sources: The owner's answers, 16 inspiration screenshots, research/competitive-analysis.md, CLAUDE.md, PLAN.md, the dashboard code and pattern research captured 25 Nov 2026
provenance.rule: Nothing is built yet, so every step is planned. Where the owner's decisions and the project documents disagree, the owner's decision is stated and the difference is a gap.

brief.product: A Chrome extension that measures digital habits (streaming, AI prompts, browsing), shows the estimated CO2 and water they cause as ranges, and points people to offsetting. For v0 only its frontend screens are built, as web pages with sample data and no backend.
brief.market: Global, English-language, Chrome Web Store, used on a desktop computer

admired.why: Sign in, then a dashboard with side navigation, range tabs, KPI cards, an offset banner, projects and account pages
Breakdown by activity category, tips, and a leaderboard with tabs and a podium
Offset by choosing an amount and a project type, with a live CO2 conversion
Compact tabs (Overview, Analytics, Settings, Offset); per-site activity and pause tracking

brief.manual_today: Most people never check; a few type numbers from memory into one-off web carbon calculators
brief.flows_asked: F1 Sign up and onboarding, F2 Check my metrics, F3 Offset my impact, F4 Leaderboard, F5 Settings

goals.value: Create an account and set up Ecobex, then land on the dashboard
See the CO2 and water of their digital habits as ranges, by category and over time
Find ways to offset, seeing provider, price per tonne and standard before leaving for the provider's site
Compare their week-on-week change with others on a leaderboard they choose to join
Change what is tracked, their goal, profile and visibility; pause tracking; clear data and sign out

constraints.value: Frontend only: no backend, database or server
Sample usage only, no real tracking; labelled as sample
Sign-up asks for name and email, no password; saved in localStorage with a comment saying it is a demo
Every number is an estimate (range and central value) traceable to factors.js; water beside CO2 only where sourced; method one tap away
Offset: show provider, price per tonne and standard before leaving; only link out; no payments
Habits without a figure (video calls; streaming water) are listed as 'not estimated yet' with no number
Available components lack modal, toast, empty state and sidebar navigation; side navigation must be added
No manual entry of habits anywhere in the flows
Before any browsing data is collected, the extension shows a prominent disclosure in its own screens and the person takes an affirmative action to agree (Chrome Web Store user data policy)
Offset copy says 'contribute'; no claim that the person or product is carbon neutral or climate positive (EU Directive 2024/825 from 27 Sep 2026; UK CMA Green Claims Code)

decisions.value: Usage is tracked automatically by the extension; nobody types habits into a calculator. In v0 the screens show sample usage standing in for what the extension will measure. The existing Calculator and Results pages retire.
Sign-up first, then onboarding, then dashboard
decisions.conflicts_with: CLAUDE.md:6, 47, 55-56 and PLAN.md:73 (no account needed to see value; no accounts in v0)

decisions.value: Side navigation: Metrics, Offset, Leaderboard, Settings
Onboarding: Back on every step, Skip on Your goal and Pin Ecobex, answers saved as they go
Leaderboard ranks % change against each person's own last week; opt-in with a nickname; sample players in v0
Settings: habits and goal, profile and leaderboard visibility, pause tracking, clear data and sign out
First visit shows sample data labelled 'sample', no % change until there is a previous week; ranges Today, 7 days, 30 days
Offset provider shown as an 'example' card until one is chosen

Contribute: choose a project from three or four cards showing provider, project, removal or avoidance, standard, price per tonne and the cost of the last 30 days; review a summary; continue to the provider's page in a new tab
On return, ask 'Did you contribute?'; a yes is saved in the browser and listed separately; the footprint stays as measured
Settings sits in a separate utility group at the bottom of the side navigation

flows.name: Sign up and onboarding
flows.trigger: Ecobex has just been installed from the Chrome Web Store
flows.measure: Seven screens from the welcome tab to the dashboard, two of them skippable; target under two minutes, to be tested

steps.label: Welcome
steps.user: Reads what Ecobex does and clicks Get started
steps.system: Shows one line on what Ecobex measures, a progress indicator (1 of 6) and Get started; 'Already have an account? Sign in' below

steps.label: Enter name, email
steps.user: Types a name and an email and continues
steps.system: Checks the email format, saves name and email in this browser only (demo, no password) and moves on
steps.requires: A name and a valid email

steps.label: Agree to tracking
steps.user: Reads what is measured and what is never seen, then agrees
steps.system: Lists what is measured (time, data, AI prompt counts and site domains, kept on this device) and what is never collected (full URLs, page content, prompt text); tracking starts only after 'Agree and start tracking'
steps.requires: An affirmative agreement (Chrome Web Store policy)

steps.label: Pick a goal
steps.user: Chooses Reduce my footprint, Understand it, or Contribute for what I can't reduce
steps.system: Saves the goal; Back and Skip are available

steps.label: Choose habits
steps.user: Switches video streaming and AI chats on or off
steps.system: Saves the choices; browsing and video calls are listed as 'not estimated yet' because factors.js has no figure for them

steps.label: Pin Ecobex
steps.user: Pins the icon from Chrome's puzzle-piece menu, or skips
steps.system: Shows where the puzzle-piece menu is and what pinning gives; Skip keeps it on the setup checklist

steps.label: See dashboard
steps.system: Shows the footprint with sample usage labelled 'Sample', and a setup checklist for any skipped step

flows.success: Onboarding is marked complete; the person is on Metrics with tracking agreed, and the next visit goes straight to the dashboard

branches.label: Sign in

steps.label: Enter email
steps.system: Finds the account saved in this browser and opens Metrics

branches.note: Works only in the browser where the account was created; there is no backend in v0

steps.label: Fix email
steps.user: Reads the message and corrects the email
steps.system: Says what is wrong: a missing @ or a missing domain such as .com

branches.label: Not now

steps.label: Read why
steps.system: Explains that Ecobex cannot measure anything without agreement and that nothing has been collected; keeps the place in onboarding

branches.note: The welcome tab can be reopened later (E8) and resumes at this step

steps.label: Skip goal
steps.system: Leaves the goal unset and adds 'Set a goal' to the setup checklist

branches.label: Closed

steps.label: Leave midway
steps.system: Keeps every answer given so far in this browser

branches.note: Reopening the welcome tab resumes at the last unfinished step

steps.label: Skip pinning
steps.system: Adds 'Pin Ecobex' to the setup checklist on Metrics

acceptance.when: the person finishes or skips every step
acceptance.then: they land on Metrics and the next visit opens Metrics directly
no usage is recorded and reopening the welcome tab returns to the consent screen
the form stays on the step and says the email needs an @

open_questions.question: Sign-up first conflicts with the confirmed proposition 'no account needed to see value' (CLAUDE.md:6, PLAN.md:73). Keep sign-up first and reword the proposition, or revisit?
What do the three goals change later in the product, if anything?
Should the Pin step detect that Ecobex is pinned (the Chrome extensions action API can report it: https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/reference/api/action), or only explain it?

flows.name: Check my metrics
flows.trigger: Wants to know what their digital habits cost the planet this week
flows.measure: CO₂ and water ranges readable on arrival without scrolling; any category in one click

steps.label: Open Metrics
steps.user: Opens Metrics from the side navigation
steps.system: Shows Today by default with the 'Sample' label in v0

steps.label: Read CO₂ and water
steps.system: Shows CO₂ and water each as a central value with a shaded range and '≈', an everyday equivalent such as phone charges, and the change against the previous period

steps.label: Change period
steps.user: Switches between Today, 7 days and 30 days
steps.system: Updates totals, the trend chart and the category list

steps.label: Open a category
steps.user: Clicks a category such as Video streaming
steps.system: Shows that category's range, its share of the total, its top sites by domain and the trend

steps.label: See the method
steps.system: Shows the figure used, its range, confidence and source from factors.js in a panel on the same screen

flows.success: The person knows the range of their CO₂ and water for the chosen period, which category drives it, and where each number comes from

steps.label: See paused banner
steps.system: Says tracking is paused and until when, with Resume

steps.label: No comparison
steps.system: Shows no % change and says the comparison appears after the first full week

steps.label: See not estimated
steps.user: Opens video calls, or water for streaming
steps.system: Shows the habit with 'not estimated yet' and no number, with a line on why

acceptance.given: a person on their first day
acceptance.then: the totals show as ranges labelled 'Sample' and no % change is shown
it shows 'not estimated yet' and no number

acceptance.when: the person opens 'How is this calculated?'
acceptance.then: the factor, its range and its source link from factors.js are shown

open_questions.question: Which everyday equivalents should Metrics use? Every product picks a different set (phone charges, km driven, bottles, Netflix minutes).
The method panel covers one figure; the full 'How we calculate' page is in the second run. Is a panel enough for v0?

flows.name: Contribute to a climate project
flows.trigger: Sees their footprint and wants to do something about what they cannot reduce
flows.measure: Provider, price per tonne and standard seen before leaving; three clicks from the side navigation to the provider's page

steps.label: Open Contribute
steps.user: Opens Contribute from the side navigation or the card on Metrics
steps.system: Shows the last 30 days as a CO₂ range and explains that contributing funds a project and does not cancel their emissions

steps.label: Compare projects
steps.user: Reads three or four project cards
steps.system: Each card shows provider, project, type (removal or avoidance), standard, price per tonne and 'your last 30 days ≈ $ at this price'

steps.label: Review summary
steps.system: Shows a summary with the same facts, what the provider will ask for, and Continue to provider

steps.label: Continue to provider
steps.system: Opens the provider's project page in a new tab; Ecobex takes no payment

steps.label: Record contribution
steps.user: Comes back and answers 'Did you contribute?'
steps.system: If yes, saves the project and date in this browser and lists it under 'Your contributions'; the footprint stays as measured

flows.success: The provider's page has opened in a new tab after the person saw provider, price per tonne and standard; a contribution is recorded if they said so, and the footprint is unchanged

branches.label: Not yet

steps.label: See example cards
steps.system: Labels every card 'Example' and disables Continue to provider until real providers are chosen

branches.note: The v0 state until the open provider decision is made

steps.label: Cover longer
steps.user: Picks 3 months or a year instead
steps.system: Recalculates the amount and the cost for the longer period

steps.label: Back to projects
steps.system: Returns to the cards with the scroll kept

steps.label: Read link
steps.system: Keeps the summary open with the provider's address to try again later

steps.label: Nothing saved
steps.system: Records nothing and closes the question

acceptance.then: it shows provider, standard, removal or avoidance, price per tonne and the cost for their last 30 days

acceptance.when: the person clicks Continue to provider
acceptance.then: the provider's page opens in a new tab and no payment happens in Ecobex
the footprint is unchanged and the contribution is listed separately

open_questions.question: Which three or four verified providers and projects, at what price per tonne and to which standard? None is chosen yet (PLAN.md:76).
Do the chosen providers accept amounts as small as a month of digital use? Gold Standard sells per tonne and its minimum was not found.
Should Ecobex list tree-planting providers that say they are not certified offsets, or only certified ones?
Are referral or affiliate links allowed? They would affect how neutral the list is.

flows.name: Leaderboard
flows.trigger: Curious how their week compares with others
flows.measure: Joined and ranked in two steps; own position always visible

steps.label: Open Leaderboard
steps.user: Opens Leaderboard from the side navigation
steps.system: Shows the board of sample players, clearly labelled 'Sample players', ranked by % change against each player's own last week, with Join

steps.label: Choose a nickname
steps.user: Clicks Join and types a nickname
steps.system: Explains that only the nickname and the % change are shown, never the name, email or totals

steps.label: See my rank
steps.system: Adds the person under their nickname and pins their own row, even below the visible top of the list

flows.success: The person appears on the weekly board under a nickname, ranked by change against their own last week, and can see their own row

steps.label: Browse board
steps.system: Keeps Join available; nothing about the person is shown

steps.label: Change nickname
steps.system: Says the nickname is empty or already used

steps.label: Not ranked yet
steps.system: Shows 'Not ranked yet: you'll appear after your first full week'

acceptance.given: a person who has not joined
acceptance.then: they see only sample players and a Join button, and no data of theirs

acceptance.given: a person in their first week

acceptance.when: they turn off leaderboard visibility in Settings
acceptance.then: their row disappears from the board

open_questions.question: Does a week with tracking paused count towards the ranking, or is it shown as a partial week?
% change rewards heavy users most (the largest drops come from the highest users). Should the change be capped or banded?
Should two people whose ranges overlap be shown as tied?
Does the week reset on the person's local Sunday or at one global time?

flows.name: Settings
flows.trigger: Wants to change what Ecobex tracks, how they appear, or to stop tracking for a while
flows.measure: Any setting changed in two clicks from Settings, saved without a separate Save step

steps.label: Open Settings
steps.user: Opens Settings from the utility group at the bottom of the side navigation
steps.system: Shows sections: Tracking, Goal, Profile and leaderboard, Pause, Data and account

steps.label: Edit tracking
steps.user: Switches a habit on or off or changes the goal
steps.system: Saves at once and says that past figures for that habit stay in history

steps.label: Pause tracking
steps.user: Chooses Pause for 1 hour, until tomorrow, or until I resume
steps.system: Pauses at once, says paused time cannot be filled in later, and shows a paused banner on Metrics

steps.label: See confirmation
steps.user: Reads the note under the changed setting
steps.system: Shows 'Saved' under the setting; Resume appears if tracking is paused

flows.success: The change is saved in this browser and Metrics and the Leaderboard reflect it on the next visit

steps.label: Edit name, email, nickname
steps.user: Changes name, email or nickname, or turns leaderboard visibility off
steps.system: Saves at once; turning visibility off removes them from the board

steps.label: Fix email
steps.system: Says what is wrong with it and keeps the old email until it is valid

steps.label: Auto-resume
steps.system: Has resumed tracking at the chosen time and says so once on Metrics

steps.label: Confirm on a page
steps.user: Clicks Clear data, reads what will go, and types CLEAR
steps.system: Shows a confirmation page listing what is deleted and that it cannot be undone

steps.label: Start again
steps.system: Deletes account, answers, history and contributions from this browser and opens the welcome tab

steps.label: Signed out
steps.system: Keeps the data in this browser and shows Sign in

acceptance.then: tracking resumes and Metrics says so once

acceptance.when: the person confirms by typing CLEAR
acceptance.then: nothing Ecobex stored remains in the browser and the welcome tab opens
past figures for that habit stay in history and no new usage is added

open_questions.question: When a habit is switched off, should its past figures stay in totals, be hidden, or be deleted?
Should Clear data offer an export first? GreenQuery, which needs no account, offers CSV export.

research.product: Offset claim rules: CMA Green Claims Code, EU 2024/825, Oxford Offsetting Principles
notes: CMA: name the scheme, do not imply zero emissions
EU 2024/825 via Heuking commentary: no neutral claims based on offsets from 27 Sep 2026
Oxford Offsetting Principles (https://www.smithschool.ox.ac.uk/research/oxford-offsetting-principles): keep contribution claims apart from compensation claims
Nearest pattern to ranking change against one's own baseline
Leaving is done by making the profile private
Average 2.0% reduction; 6.3% in the highest-use decile, 0.3% in the lowest (abstract)
Paused time cannot be recovered
A timed pause resumed with no alert, per a 2022 forum thread: https://community.rescuetime.com/t/notification-when-tracking-is-unpaused/87

research.product: MOJ Design System: confirm an action
notes: Confirms on a full page rather than a modal
Typed confirmation for rare, irreversible actions

gaps.gap: Project rules say there are no accounts and value comes without one; the owner decided sign-up comes first
The planned onboarding has no consent step, which the Chrome Web Store requires before any browsing data is collected
No verified provider, price per tonne or standard is chosen, so Contribute can only show example cards
Sign in works only in the browser where the account was made; on another browser the person is stuck with no account
gaps.where: F1 branch 'Have an account?'; CLAUDE.md:44 (no backend)

gaps.gap: The copied Untitled UI set has no side navigation, toast or empty-state component, all of which these flows use
Current pages are Home, Calculator and Results for typing habits in by hand, which the automatic-tracking decision retires
The Home page promises video calls and water for every habit; factors.js has no video-call figure and no streaming water
Leaderboard, Settings and Contribute choices are in no PLAN.md step
What a signed-out person sees when they reopen the dashboard is not designed; the flows assume Sign in
PLAN.md has the dashboard show prompts and energy as well; F2 leads with CO₂ and water only
CLAUDE.md says the dashboard shows whatever the user types in onboarding, which the automatic-tracking decision replaces
Whether chosen providers accept amounts as small as a month of digital use is unknown
gaps.where: Research R11 (per-tonne pricing, minimum not found)

recommendations.text: Update CLAUDE.md and PLAN.md to record sign-up first, the consent step, automatic tracking, side navigation, Contribute, Leaderboard and Settings, and reword the proposition's 'no account needed' line
Put the consent screen straight after sign-up and start (sample) tracking only after it is agreed
Choose three or four certified providers with a published price per tonne and minimum, preferring removals as PLAN.md already says, and confirm they accept small amounts before building Contribute
Add side navigation, toast and empty-state components to the copied Untitled UI set before building the dashboard
Retire the Calculator and Results pages and fix the Home copy so it promises only habits with a sourced figure
Tell people on the Sign in screen that their account lives in this browser only, so another browser does not look like a lost account
Show ranges as a central value with a shaded band and one plain-language line
